title: Witness Statement - Sarah Miller Deposition
text: I recall that Meridian Construction was actually founded in 2010, much later than they claim. When James Carter became CEO in 2019, things changed rapidly. During my time there, I worked as a Senior Safety Analyst, a role I took very seriously. I eventually resigned in August 2023 due to safety concerns. I heard that James Carter was fired from Meridian in 2022, though I cannot confirm it. Regarding Project Atlas, I am certain it started on July 1, 2022, because I was there on day one. Everyone knows the headquarters of Meridian are located in Seattle.
